# Jordi Nimutan

> > Leadership development and organizational transformation for scaling startups and enterprises in the Philippines.

Jordi Nimutan provides executive coaching and structured training programs designed to develop leaders at all levels, from founders transitioning to CEOs to middle managers building high-performing teams. The site combines practical frameworks for decision-making, delegation, and organizational culture with industry-specific programs for hospitality and digital transformation.

## Key Topics

- Decision-Making
- Leadership Development
- Delegation
- Startup Scaling
- Founder-to-CEO
- Organizational Structure
- Team Management
- Operational Efficiency
- Company Culture
- Leadership Training
- Performance Management
- Strategic Leadership
- Organizational Development
- Digital Transformation
- Founder Bottleneck

## Leadership Development Programs

- [Strategic Leadership Mastery Program (SLMP): Advancing Middle Management Skills](https://jordanimutan.com/strategic-leadership-mastery-program-slmp-advancing-middle-management-skills): SLMP developing middle management skills in strategic leadership and innovation
- [Leadership Excellence Accelerator Program (LEAP): Empowering Middle Managers](https://jordanimutan.com/listleadership-excellence-accelerator-program-leap-empowering-middle-managerslist): LEAP program training middle managers in emotional intelligence and communication
- [Comprehensive Employee Development (CED) Program for the Hospitality Industry](https://jordanimutan.com/comprehensive-employee-development-ced-program-for-the-hospitality-industry): CED Program offering hospitality staff training in guest service and team management
- [Is Your Company AI-Ready?](https://jordanimutan.com/is-your-company-ai-ready): AI readiness survey aligned with Philippines' National AI Strategy (NAIS-PH)

## Core Services & About

- [Too many companies have untrained leaders that fail.](https://jordanimutan.com): Homepage introducing Jordi Nimutan's leadership development services for startup scaling

## Decision-Making & Delegation

- [Speed Dies When Authority Is Unclear](https://jordanimutan.com/2026/03/05/speed-dies-when-authority-is-unclear): Article on authority clarity's impact on organizational execution speed
- [The Real Reason Decisions Keep Moving Up](https://jordanimutan.com/2026/03/11/the-real-reason-decisions-keep-moving-up): Article on decision escalation patterns and delegation in organizations
- [When Managers Stop Deciding, Organizations Start Drifting](https://jordanimutan.com/2026/03/13/when-managers-stop-deciding-organizations-start-drifting): Article on management decision-making and organizational drift prevention
- [The System Always Knows Who Really Decides](https://jordanimutan.com/2026/03/11/the-system-always-knows-who-really-decides): Article on informal decision-making systems and organizational bottlenecks
- [Alignment Is Often a Delay Mechanism](https://jordanimutan.com/2026/03/05/alignment-is-often-a-delay-mechanism): Article on how alignment processes can become execution delays

## Founder & CEO Scaling

- [From Solo Founder to CEO](https://jordanimutan.com/2026/03/21/from-solo-founder-to-ceo): Article on scaling startups and transitioning from founder to CEO role
- [The Price of "Got a Minute?"](https://jordanimutan.com/2026/03/21/the-price-of-got-a-minute): Article on how open-door policies can hinder startup growth and delegation
- [You Think People Aren't Taking Ownership. They Think It's Not Safe To.](https://jordanimutan.com/2026/03/21/you-think-people-arent-taking-ownership-they-think-its-not-safe-to): Article on decision safety and organizational culture affecting employee ownership

## Organizational Performance & Culture

- [The Work Is Getting Done. The Outcome Isn't.](https://jordanimutan.com/2026/03/21/the-work-is-getting-done-the-outcome-isnt): Article on outcome versus activity in organizational performance management
- [The First Sign a Company Is Slowing Down](https://jordanimutan.com/2026/03/13/the-first-sign-a-company-is-slowing-down): Article identifying early signs of organizational slowdown and decision delays
